title: TDOC Records Request—Refund Policies for Paid Messages Rejected, Blocked, or Left Pending

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Tennessee Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Subject: TDOC Records Request—Refund Policies for Paid Messages Rejected, Blocked, or Left Pending

To the Tennessee Department of Correction Public Records Coordinator:

Pursuant to the Tennessee Public Records Act, I request electronic copies of existing records concerning paid electronic messages sent through GTL/ConnectNetwork, ViaPath, or any other messaging provider used by TDOC.

I have paid to send messages that have been rejected or remain pending without delivery. I am requesting records showing the applicable refund policy, the message-review process, and the basis for retaining payment when a message is not delivered.

Please provide:

1. Refund policies: Current policies governing refunds, credits, or restoration of messaging stamps for messages that are rejected, blocked, canceled, undelivered, or left pending. Include deadlines, eligibility requirements, exclusions, and instructions for requesting reimbursement.
2. Message-review rules: Policies governing screening, rejection reasons, pending status, review time limits, notification to the sender, and appeals of rejected messages.
3. Vendor agreements: Current contracts, amendments, and provisions addressing message charges, refunds, undelivered messages, customer complaints, and responsibility for issuing refunds.
4. Payment handling: Records showing when payment or messaging credits are deducted, whether rejected messages generate revenue for TDOC or the vendor, and any applicable revenue-sharing arrangements.
5. Records concerning my messages: From September 1, 2026, through the date this request is received, records concerning paid messages sent by Donald Askew Jr. to Tony Von Carruthers at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution. Include available message-status histories, review timestamps, rejection codes or reasons, reviewer notes, payment deductions, and refund or credit transactions. I can provide message IDs, screenshots, and account identifiers privately to locate these records.
6. Complaint procedures: Existing instructions for disputing charges, appealing message rejections, reporting prolonged pending status, and contacting the office or vendor responsible for resolving these issues.

Please provide the refund policy and message-review rules first if other records require additional processing.

This request seeks existing records and does not ask TDOC to create a new report. If responsive records are maintained by a contractor on TDOC’s behalf, please include those records to the extent accessible to TDOC.

If any portion is withheld, please identify the specific legal basis and release reasonably segregable portions. If no responsive refund policy exists or no responsive records are located, please state that in writing.

Please provide records electronically through MuckRock. Notify me of any estimated fees before incurring them. If identification or proof of Tennessee citizenship is required, please provide instructions for submitting it securely.

Sincerely,
Donald Askew Jr.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kent Hoover, a citizen of Tennessee, in coordination with Donald R. Askew Jr..
